chunks: And it is narrated that he said, peace be upon him:

key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.نَيْرُوزُنَا: our Nayrouz; our day of festivity or renewal

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Our Nayrouz is every day" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys that joy, blessing, and renewal are not confined to a single calendrical festival. For the followers of the Imam عليه السلام, every day can be a day of goodness and blessed meaning.
